raw:
@q query
  select ?n
  rank lowest ?t
  where all
    match
      relation "be a notary in"
      role subject ?n
      role location "Iași"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "have appointment term for"
      role subject ?n
      role object "power of attorney for sale"
      role time ?t
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end

@a1 assumed
  relation "need by"
  role subject "the user"
  role time "Friday"
  polarity affirmed
  basis implicature
